description: Edit a Mailchimp campaign that is still a DRAFT: name, subject, previewText, fromName, replyTo, templateId, or its audience / segment. A scheduled one must be unscheduled first (cancel_mailchimp_campaign). Read back with its send checklist. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Settings > Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: update_mailchimp_campaign
title: Update a Mailchimp campaign draft
